sentences.en: My motto is: Comfort the afflicted and afflict the comfortable.
sentences.zh: 我的座右铭是：安慰受苦的人，挑战安逸的人。

sentences.en: "Liberty, equality, fraternity" is also the national motto of Haiti.
sentences.zh: "自由、平等、博爱" 也是海地的国箴言。

sentences.en: One for all, and all for one, this is our motto.
sentences.zh: 人人为我，我为人人，这是我们的座右铭。
